_source_note: Unlike data/synthea_samples (real Synthea-generated patient data), every file in this directory is entirely fabricated for exercising the OCR pipeline (Stage 2 of Architecture Plan.txt) end to end -- no real patient, encounter, or claim underlies them. 'John Smith (PAT-770231)' is not a real patient id in any index. The CPT/ICD codes used (99213, 62323, 72100, M51.36) are real, existing codes chosen for plausibility, but they were not verified live against an official source (CMS/AMA) in the session that generated these fixtures, and they are not tied to any real clinical scenario -- do not use these files as adjudication test cases or cite their codes as verified without checking them the way the rest of this repo's golden rule requires.

files.purpose: Exercises the Tesseract OCR path for a standalone image file (engine=tesseract). Verified similarity to source text ~0.99 with real Tesseract 5.4.0; observed real misreads of digit '0' as '@' in dates/dosages on this font -- a genuine OCR limitation, not injected.
Exercises pdf_text on a tabular billing layout.

Exercises Tesseract on a tabular billing layout. Observed real limitation: image_to_string loses row alignment on tables (groups all descriptions, then all codes, then all charges, instead of per-row) -- plain OCR here is not table-structure-aware.

files.type: image-only PDF (clinical_note.png embedded via Pillow, no text layer)
files.purpose: Exercises the in-PDF fallback: pdfplumber finds no text layer on the page, so extract.py renders the page and routes it to Tesseract, same as a real scanned document upload.
